module.name: Gateway API Reference Grant
module.description: Creates Gateway API ReferenceGrant custom resource to allow cross-namespace references between Gateway API resources (Gateways, Routes, Services).

required.reason: FLO provides ReferenceGrant CRD and Gateway API support

optional.reason: Grants typically allow cross-namespace references to Gateways
optional.provides: Gateway resources that can be referenced

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: grant_namespace
required.description: Namespace where grant will be deployed (typically the 'to' namespace)

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

required.name: from_namespaces
required.description: Namespaces that are allowed to reference resources

required.name: to_resources
required.description: Resource types that can be referenced (e.g., Gateway, Service)

optional.name: to_resource_names
optional.description: Specific resource names that can be referenced (empty = all)

key_outputs.name: grant_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating grant is accepted and active
